hero.headline: Airport Transfers in Addis Ababa
hero.subheadline: Arrange a reliable transfer between Bole International Airport and your hotel. We confirm availability and pricing after your request.

howItWorks.title: Submit Your Details
howItWorks.description: Share your flight info, arrival/departure time, and hotel or destination.

howItWorks.title: We Confirm
howItWorks.description: Our team reviews your request and confirms vehicle availability and pricing.

howItWorks.title: Travel with Confidence
howItWorks.description: Your driver meets you at the airport and takes you safely to your destination.

form.headline: Request an Airport Transfer
form.subheadline: Fill out the form below and we'll confirm your transfer within 24 hours.
form.disclosure: Pickup details, vehicle availability, and final pricing are confirmed after we review your request.

faqs.question: Do you offer meet-and-greet at the airport?
faqs.answer: Driver meeting arrangements can be discussed after your transfer is confirmed. Specific meet-and-greet services depend on availability.

faqs.question: What if my flight is delayed?
faqs.answer: Let us know your updated arrival time. We'll adjust the driver schedule based on your new flight details.

faqs.question: Can I book a round-trip transfer?
faqs.answer: Yes. Request both arrival and departure transfers in the same form and we'll coordinate both.

faqs.question: Do you provide child seats?
faqs.answer: Child seats can be arranged upon request. Mention this in the special requirements field.
